description: Complete 14-cell differential with all precursors and mature cell lines. Default for comprehensive bone marrow and peripheral blood analysis. Left-hand ergonomic key layout.

ME_ratio.label: M:E Ratio (excl. monocytes)
ME_ratio.basis: Alternative convention: granulocytes and their precursors only, EXCLUDING monocytes and promonocytes, over erythroblasts at all stages. ICSH 2008 §2.6 includes monocytes; this profile deliberately does not. Ratios from the two conventions are not comparable.

specimenTypes.targetCountBasis: ICSH 2008 §2.6: at least 500 cells when a precise percentage of an abnormal cell type is required for diagnosis; at least 300 when the differential is not essential to it.

specimenTypes.targetCountBasis: CLSI H20-A2: 200 leucocytes for a reference differential.

provenance.citation: Lee S-H et al. ICSH guidelines for the standardization of bone marrow specimens and reports. Int J Lab Hematol 2008;30(5):349-364.
provenance.notes: Cell categories follow ICSH 2008 §2.6. The M:E ratio uses the alternative convention that EXCLUDES monocytes and their precursors from the myeloid numerator. ICSH includes them; both conventions are in use and give different ratios from identical counts.
